title: The Philidor position
line: The rook on the third row holds the draw.

steps.text: This is the Philidor position. Your king stands in front of the pawn, and your rook holds the third row from your side.
Here the white king cannot step onto that row, and without it the pawn cannot get through.
Wait with the rook along its row, out of reach of the white pieces.

steps.text: The pawn has stepped onto your rook's row. Now the white king has no shelter: drop the rook to the far end.

summary: Hold the third row with the rook. When the pawn steps onto it, drop the rook back and check from behind.
